g.text: Q1/R45/R37: PIN3 overvoltage lockout, TI SLVSFC9C Fig. 8-13 (Option 2). U10 OVLO has its own 1M/68k divider (18.85 V rising, same as PIN1).

g.desc: Q1/R45/R37: PIN3 overvoltage lockout, TI SLVSFC9C Fig. 8-13 (Option 2). U10 OVLO has its own 1M/68k divider (18.85 V rising, same as PIN1).

g.text: Q1 (source follower, gate AUXOFF1 at 3.3 V via R36) lifts U10 OVLO to ~1.85-2.65 V while PIN1 is the active source, so PIN1 keeps priority.

g.desc: Q1 (source follower, gate AUXOFF1 at 3.3 V via R36) lifts U10 OVLO to ~1.85-2.65 V while PIN1 is the active source, so PIN1 keeps priority.

g.text: With U9 unpowered AUXOFF1 sits at <=1.0 V (VPGD), so Q1 can lift OVLO to at most ~0.6 V, below the 1.18 V threshold: verify PIN3-only startup on the isolated fixture.

g.desc: With U9 unpowered AUXOFF1 sits at <=1.0 V (VPGD), so Q1 can lift OVLO to at most ~0.6 V, below the 1.18 V threshold: verify PIN3-only startup on the isolated fixture.

g.text: U11 SRV05-4: ESD steering array on the three bus lines (J1 pins 4/5/7), clamped to +5V/GND; replaces BAV99 D1-D3.

g.desc: U11 SRV05-4: ESD steering array on the three bus lines (J1 pins 4/5/7), clamped to +5V/GND; replaces BAV99 D1-D3.

g.text: TP12: buck output before D11. JP3: normally closed post-D11 service link. Cut only on a disconnected board. Common ground remains. C30: optional bulk capacitor (DNP).

g.desc: TP12: buck output before D11. JP3: normally closed post-D11 service link. Cut only on a disconnected board. Common ground remains. C30: optional bulk capacitor (DNP).

g.text: 7 APPLIANCE INPUT eFUSES / PIN1-PRIORITY POWER MUX (TI TPS259470A, SLVSFC9C Fig. 8-13 Option 2)

g.desc: 7 APPLIANCE INPUT eFUSES / PIN1-PRIORITY POWER MUX (TI TPS259470A, SLVSFC9C Fig. 8-13 Option 2)

g.text: U9 AUXOFF1 (R36 pull-up to +3V3) drives Q1 gate; Q1 source drives U10 OVLO alongside the R45/R37 divider.

g.desc: U9 AUXOFF1 (R36 pull-up to +3V3) drives Q1 gate; Q1 source drives U10 OVLO alongside the R45/R37 divider.

g.text: PIN1 below UVLO no longer inhibits PIN3. Both eFuses block reverse current, so their outputs tie to V_INPUT without OR diodes.

g.desc: PIN1 below UVLO no longer inhibits PIN3. Both eFuses block reverse current, so their outputs tie to V_INPUT without OR diodes.

g.text: U9 OVLO (R44/R33) locks PIN1 out above ~18.9 V and hands over to PIN3; U10 EN uses a single 360k pull-up per TI note (>=350k).

g.desc: U9 OVLO (R44/R33) locks PIN1 out above ~18.9 V and hands over to PIN3; U10 EN uses a single 360k pull-up per TI note (>=350k).

g.text: J5/J6 are two separate 1x07 female sockets for a user-installed XIAO ESP32-C3 or C6 module.

g.desc: J5/J6 are two separate 1x07 female sockets for a user-installed XIAO ESP32-C3 or C6 module.

g.text: Native USB remains on the module; RESET is via the onboard button. No factory-module underside pads are connected.

g.desc: Native USB remains on the module; RESET is via the onboard button. No factory-module underside pads are connected.

g.text: JP2: module GEA3 TX source. Default 1-2 = D6 (UART0 TX, emits ROM boot text at reset). Cut 1-2 and bridge 2-3 to use D4 (C3 GPIO6 / C6 GPIO22, silent at boot; firmware change required).

g.desc: JP2: module GEA3 TX source. Default 1-2 = D6 (UART0 TX, emits ROM boot text at reset). Cut 1-2 and bridge 2-3 to use D4 (C3 GPIO6 / C6 GPIO22, silent at boot; firmware change required).

g.text: TP8/TP9: appliance PIN1/PIN3 after the connector. TP10/TP11: eFuse ILM current monitor (V proportional to channel current).

g.desc: TP8/TP9: appliance PIN1/PIN3 after the connector. TP10/TP11: eFuse ILM current monitor (V proportional to channel current).

g.text: Isolated bench: connect one source only. Keep R38 fitted to define U10 EN. FLT pads TP17/18 need an external pull-up for measurement. dV/dt and ITIMER use defaults.

g.desc: Isolated bench: connect one source only. Keep R38 fitted to define U10 EN. FLT pads TP17/18 need an external pull-up for measurement. dV/dt and ITIMER use defaults.

g.text: 4 SHARED XIAO C3/C6 SOCKETS / UART / LEDS

g.desc: 4 SHARED XIAO C3/C6 SOCKETS / UART / LEDS

g.text: Appliance pin 1 / pin 3 selection is automatic: U9/U10 TPS259470A eFuses (reverse blocking, UVLO, ILIM) in TI priority power-mux; D18/D20 protect the raw inputs; U11 clamps the data lines.

g.desc: Appliance pin 1 / pin 3 selection is automatic: U9/U10 TPS259470A eFuses (reverse blocking, UVLO, ILIM) in TI priority power-mux; D18/D20 protect the raw inputs; U11 clamps the data lines.

g.text: U8 AP63205 buck output BUCK_5V reaches the +5V rail through D11, which blocks backfeed into the buck.

g.desc: U8 AP63205 buck output BUCK_5V reaches the +5V rail through D11, which blocks backfeed into the buck.

g.text: J5/J6 accept a pre-headered XIAO ESP32-C3 or C6; 3V3 supplies carrier logic only. No battery/underside pads are connected. Native USB remains on the module.

g.desc: J5/J6 accept a pre-headered XIAO ESP32-C3 or C6; 3V3 supplies carrier logic only. No battery/underside pads are connected. Native USB remains on the module.

g.text: Both modules tie header 5V to USB VBUS. D11 protects the buck, not the USB host; no simultaneous-source protection is provided.

g.desc: Both modules tie header 5V to USB VBUS. D11 protects the buck, not the USB host; no simultaneous-source protection is provided.

g.text: CONNECT ONLY ONE SUPPLY AT A TIME: USB or appliance. Physically disconnect the appliance cable before USB connection.

g.desc: CONNECT ONLY ONE SUPPLY AT A TIME: USB or appliance. Physically disconnect the appliance cable before USB connection.

g.text: U9/U10 TPS259470A: see section 7. DNP = do not populate: test points and mounting holes are not assembled components.

g.desc: U9/U10 TPS259470A: see section 7. DNP = do not populate: test points and mounting holes are not assembled components.

g.text: Use the installed module's own BOOT and RESET buttons. No carrier recovery header.

g.desc: Use the installed module's own BOOT and RESET buttons. No carrier recovery header.

g.text: D9 / BOOT is C3 GPIO9, but C6 GPIO20 (not C6 BOOT). C6 BOOT is not on the side headers.

g.desc: D9 / BOOT is C3 GPIO9, but C6 GPIO20 (not C6 BOOT). C6 BOOT is not on the side headers.

g.text: R1/R2/R5 retain C3 strap pull-ups. JP1 default 1-2 uses D3; engineering alternate 2-3 uses D9.

g.desc: R1/R2/R5 retain C3 strap pull-ups. JP1 default 1-2 uses D3; engineering alternate 2-3 uses D9.

g.text: Disconnect the appliance cable before connecting module USB. Choose matching C3/C6 firmware.

g.desc: Disconnect the appliance cable before connecting module USB. Choose matching C3/C6 firmware.
